name_en: Padang Golf Jaya Ancol (Ancol Golf Club)

fees_2026_05.notes: COURSE PERMANENTLY CLOSED. Padang Golf Jaya Ancol (33.6 ha, 18-hole RTJ Jr. course) was shut down on 24 February 2010 and converted to Ancol Ecopark / Allianz Ecopark in collaboration with the KEHATI Biodiversity Foundation. The directory entries on mscorecard.com, golftoday.co.uk, and golfshake.com are stale legacy listings reflecting pre-2010 data. No current rates exist because no golf operation exists. Phone listing +62 21 682122 is also legacy.

fees_2026_05.notes: Official rate card is the source of record (golfpondokindah.com, valid through 31 December 2026). All rates are 18-hole guest rates and INCLUDE green fee, cart sharing, caddy fee, and tax. Single-cart upgrade adds IDR 280,000 (18H). Saturday-AM is the headline IDR 3,968,000 figure; Sat-PM, Sun-AM and Sun-PM tier down per official table. Member 18-hole rate is IDR 440,000 (sharing cart). Friday is treated as a premium weekday at IDR 1,928,000.

fees_2026_05.notes: All slot-by-slot AM/PM/Night verified via Q-Access. 'Publish' = official rack rate; 'QGolf' = discounted in-app rate (the rate Indonesian residents typically pay). GoGolf summary shows 'IDR 495,000 weekday public / IDR 395,000 app' which CONFLICTS with Q-Access (995/725). The Q-Access numbers are corroborated by golfsavers.com walk-in pricing for this course and by the existing dataset's weekday 870,000 / weekend 2,000,000 (mid-tier QGolf AM/PM) — so GoGolf article likely refers to a promo or 9-hole rate. Existing dataset values (weekday 870K, weekend 2,000K, guest 2,860K) are PROMO/BLENDED, not the base publish rate; replaced with full publish + QGolf grid. Rate includes green fee, caddy and golf cart sharing. Inclusions confirmed by gogolf.co.id Indonesian language article.

fees_2026_05.notes: Official rate card (gadingrayagolf.com/green_fees.html) confirms guest weekday IDR 850,000 (Tue-Fri), Mon-PM IDR 720,000, Sat/Sun-AM IDR 2,200,000, Sat-PM IDR 1,700,000, Sun-PM IDR 1,500,000. Member rate is IDR 280,000 — a caddy/registration fee since members pay no green fee. Guest rates INCLUDE green fee, caddy fee, and golf cart sharing (per official site). The 280K member vs 850K guest gap is genuine and validated — members hold equity and pay only operational/caddy charges. Q-Access lists matching publish rates (720K Monday, 850K Tue-Fri; weekend 2,200K AM, 1,700K Sat-PM, 1,500K Sun-PM) plus QGolf-app discount tier (640-670K weekday, 1,145-1,745K weekend) for non-members. GoGolf article shows lower 800K weekday / 2,000K weekend numbers — those appear to be older or promotional figures; official site is the source of record.
fees_2026_05.verification_notes: Weekday AM/PM confirmed: Mon-PM 720K, Tue-Fri all-day 850K. Weekend AM/PM split fully resolved. Member-vs-guest gap validated as legitimate equity-membership structure with separate caddy fee. Existing dataset values (850K/2,200K/280K) confirmed correct.

fees_2026_05.notes: THREE-WAY CONFLICT RESOLVED. (1) GoGolf detailed course review (gogolf.co.id/en/golf-course/takara-golf-resort, published 2024-06 / updated 2025-11): weekday IDR 100,000 (women) / 150,000 (men); weekend IDR 345,000–455,000. Caddy included, NO buggy carts (course is walking-only). (2) GoGolf summary listing (gogolf.co.id/en/golf-tangerang) shows IDR 450,000 weekday / 650,000 weekend — this is a stale aggregated tile that conflicts with the same site's detailed review and is treated as out-of-date. (3) Playgolf.id (tigaraksagolf.com) USD 23 weekday / USD 60 weekend (~IDR 360k / 930k) is also outdated — it predates the course's repositioning as 'affordable / walking-only' under the Takara name. The 100/150K + 345-455K tier is the most recently published *and* most detailed source, and is consistent with the course's stated 'affordable / wallet-friendly' branding. Q-Access (qaccess.asia) returns ZERO results for 'takara' — the course is not on the QGolf platform, so no booking-platform corroboration available.
